website_status.description: Liveness of the campus site as last verified. Not a claim about the data.

has_adapter.description: False means nothing has ever been crawled for this campus.

counts.description: Row count per entity type. Zero is reported, never omitted.

ref.description: Permanent, globally unique public identifier. For a campus this equals slug.

website.description: Canonical origin. Two campuses do not serve on the host you would guess.

website_status.description: Liveness of the campus's public website, as last verified. 'suspended' means the host serves a suspended-account page (HTTP 200), which differs from 'unavailable'. This describes the site, not the data: a campus can be `active` here and still carry `confidence: low`, meaning nothing has been read from it yet.

source_url.description: Where this record came from. A citable URL, or seed:// for curated rows.

first_seen_at.description: When this record was first ingested.

last_verified_at.description: When the source was last confirmed to still say this. NOT when TUP updated it.

confidence.description: How much this record should be trusted. Ascending: low < medium < high. Derived from source freshness and entity type, not from parser certainty.

count.description: Number of items in this page.

has_more.description: Authoritative signal for "keep paginating". Prefer over links.next.

generated_at.description: When this response was assembled. Independent of data age — read provenance.last_verified_at for that. Deliberately excluded from the ETag.

oldest_verified_at.description: The least recently verified record in this page.

min_confidence.description: How much this record should be trusted. Ascending: low < medium < high. Derived from source freshness and entity type, not from parser certainty.

next.description: Opaque. Do not decode or construct cursors — the format may change.

type.description: URI identifying the error class. Resolves to docs.

detail.description: Names the offending value, not just the class.

did_you_mean.description: Trigram-similar identifiers, on 404 for a slug-shaped path.

ref.description: Permanent public identifier, `{campus}/{slug}`. Never contains a UUID.

unit_type.description: Organisational vocabulary of this unit. Campuses differ: Manila and Visayas use colleges, Cavite uses departments. Always read this field; never assume "college".

status.description: 'active', or 'unknown'/'removed' once the source stopped listing it.

name.example: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering

aliases.description: Source name variants the matching chain accepts. Never `null`.

program.description: Canonical program slug, or null when the source name has not been resolved into the registry. Never auto-created from a fuzzy match (ADR-003).

get.description: Reports whether the API is serving and how long since ingestion last succeeded. `hours_since_ingest` is public on purpose: the API reports its own staleness rather than asking anyone to take freshness on faith. `status` is `degraded` when the database is unreachable or ingestion has not succeeded in 36 hours.

200.description: What this is and where to go next.

get.summary: What this API actually holds, per campus
get.description: Entity counts for every campus, including the campuses with nothing. There is deliberately **no system-wide total** (ADR-012): an aggregate reads as coverage while hiding that one campus contributes none of it, which is the fact a student at that campus most needs. A campus with no adapter reports zeros and `has_adapter: false` rather than being omitted — absence would be indistinguishable from "we did not look".

get.summary: List every campus in the TUP system
get.description: Four campuses, including Taguig, which nothing has been crawled from yet. Taguig is modelled as a first-class campus rather than omitted — absence would be indistinguishable from "we did not look". Read `website_status` for whether a campus's site is answering, and `provenance.confidence` for whether we have actually read anything from it; they are different questions.

get.summary: List degrees as each campus actually publishes them
get.description: One row per degree per campus, carrying the verbatim `source_name`. This is the only view that includes offerings whose source name has not yet been resolved into the canonical registry (`program: null`) — they are real degrees a campus teaches, and hiding them until a human has classified them would misrepresent the catalogue. Filter them with `program=unmatched`.
